correctness.rationale: Reversible edge-insertion bijection counts every labelled extension exactly once. Surviving cherries have disjoint two-pendant-edge kill sets, giving an exact pure-death kernel; telescoping yields all joint inclusion moments, and falling-factorial Vandermonde plus inclusion–exclusion gives the claimed exact survivor-set law. The probability-generating polynomial evolves by f -> f + alpha(1-z)f' with alpha*deg(f)<1 and strictly interlacing roots; continuity handles multiple roots. Symmetric polarization yields real stability and established strongly Rayleigh/negative-association properties. Covariance follows by a direct rational subtraction. Standalone standard-library program checks 980 exact rational Markov/moment identities and 25 direct exhaustive leaf-grafting comparisons from differing old shapes. Finite checks corroborate, not replace the all-n all-r proof.

evidence: Choi, Kaur and Wu (2021), Section 5, treats the asymptotic numbers of current cherry and pitchfork subtrees for a process initiated from an arbitrary tree, not exact finite all-subset persistence of its initial cherries.

Borcea, Brändén and Liggett (2007), Corollary 4.7 and strong Rayleigh negative association, supplies the general polarization theorem; it does not specialize its proof to the named-tree-growth process.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Arbitrary-start global limit distributions and general stability-preservation theorems cover separate components of the proof but neither supplies the explicit marked-cherry law, topology-independence or its verified real-rooted recurrence. In particular the known stability result alone has no model-specific generator or nonpositive-root certificate.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The combined previously known framework lets one *pose* the problem and provides the final transfer theorem. The new substantive steps are to identify two nonoverlapping cherry-destroying edges per survivor, derive the exchangeable pure-death chain and half-integer-hypergeometric exact law, and show the evolution operator preserves nonpositive real roots. No inspected source establishes those claims or a strictly stronger model-specific theorem that directly subsumes them.

No checked primary full text stated the exact half-integer falling-factorial survivor law or its real-rooted death-chain application. residual_risks: An equivalent initial-tagged-cherry persistence law may exist in earlier sampling-consistency, sequential attachment, or urn-process literature under another name.

Historical catalogue searches do not prove uniqueness or absence of an earlier exact law.

value.rationale: The exact full subset law addresses which individually identified sibling pairs remain valid after adding arbitrary numbers of new named leaves, a natural finite-type reconstruction/stability question. The surprising universality across old shapes, all-order negative association (much stronger than pairwise covariance), and computable finite-sample retention probabilities are independently useful for logical type extensions and phylogenetic uncertainty. The proof is not merely a change of notation or a single low-dimensional calculation.
